notes: Read both targets and full context. Resolve farmers, U.S. jurisdiction and USDA. Retain environmental conditions on rangeland, the specific Clean Water Act expansion, expert consultation, research objective and food-versus-fuel mechanism. Agricultural-aid and tax assertions in context are not new extraction targets.

claims.claim_text: People who live and work on U.S. agricultural land are characterized as leading environmental stewards with particular understanding of safe water, clean air and open-space conservation.
Opposition to mandates that hamper U.S. agricultural production, including expanding the Clean Water Act to regulate ditches, culverts, converted cropland, and farm and stock ponds.
Support for traditional supremacy of U.S. states over water allocation.
Commitment to continue making renewable rangeland available under environmentally sound conditions.
Support for greater investment in conservation incentives to help U.S. rural communities improve and sustain environmental quality.
Support for giving careful consideration to farmers' and ranchers' expert opinions when formulating agricultural policy.
Farmers need technology producing higher yields with fewer inputs to meet increasing global demand for food and biofuel.
Support for the USDA to remain the international leader in agricultural research so the United States and the world need not choose between food and fuel.
Support for ending U.S. ethanol mandates and relying instead on the free market.
